component.name: Remota
component.summary: Multi-protocol remote connection manager for Linux

description.p: Remota is a free, open-source, multi-protocol remote connection manager for Linux. Manage and open remote sessions across many protocols from a single window — a native, open-source take on mRemoteNG for Linux.

ul.li: SSH and RDP (with NLA/CredSSP) in one tabbed window; VNC and Telnet on the way.
Organize hundreds of hosts into folders with drag-and-drop and custom icons.
Credential inheritance — set a username, SSH key or jump host on a folder and everything inside inherits it.
A local encrypted vault (AES-256-GCM + Argon2id) — your secrets never leave your machine.
Jump hosts (SSH ProxyJump) to reach private hosts through a bastion.
Reach machines behind NAT through your own self-hosted relay — a private alternative to AnyDesk, remote.it and RustDesk.
Import your existing setup straight from mRemoteNG.

description.p: Full RDP support: NLA/CredSSP, keyboard and mouse, clipboard (local to remote), and dynamic resolution that follows the window.
